title: getdesign turns a live website into design context for coding agents
friendlyTitle: getdesign explains a website’s visual style to coding agents
summary: The beta product opens a public site in a browser, reads its rendered CSS and produces a design.md covering colours, typography, spacing and components. It is available through a web dashboard, API, Bun CLI, SDK and a portable agent skill, with hosted runs using the customer’s Daytona and OpenAI keys.
friendlySummary: Give getdesign a public website address and it creates a file describing the site’s colours, fonts, spacing and parts.
whyItMatters: A structured design document can give coding agents more reliable visual context than screenshots or a vague request to copy a style. Users should still respect the source site’s rights and treat extracted design language as reference, not permission to clone a brand.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This can help an AI coding tool follow a real design more closely. Use it for guidance, not to copy someone else’s brand.
